notes.title: 0.4.0 Release – Back to the College
notes.notes: [p]The latest version of Back to the College is now live![/p][p]You can now dive deeper into the twisted, seductive, and mysterious world of campus life, where every choice shapes your destiny.[/p][list][*][p]55,000 words of story[/p][/*][*][p]2,900 images[/p][/*][*][p]95 animations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🍌 New Banana Option Available![/p][p]Some players pointed out that MC’s... equipment was a bit over the top.[/p][p]Well, we believe every experience should feel just right — even the ones below the belt.[/p][p]Starting today, you can choose: Big Banana or Massive Banana, directly from the options menu![/p][p]That’s right. Whether you prefer a touch of realism or full-on exaggeration, the choice is yours.[/p][p]After all, the world of Back to the College is big enough for every kind of fruit. 😉[/p][p]Romance, secrets, moral dilemmas, and supernatural mischief await.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45605359/de40e172db83ab31023458069204bf220f4ac40b.png"][/img][/p]
